Can I see the pebble you found?
Where did you find that pebble?
That's a lovely pebble, isn't it!
Don't hide it, I want to see it!

items.scene: a child proudly showing their drawing to a parent

lines.t: Let me see your amazing drawing!
Can I see what you drew?
What did you draw in your picture?
That's a beautiful drawing, isn't it!
Don't put it away, I want to see your picture!

items.scene: eating a favourite meal of macaroni cheese

lines.t: You love your macaroni cheese so much!
Do you like your macaroni cheese?
What's your very favourite thing to eat?
You really love that, don't you?
You never leave your macaroni cheese!

items.scene: playing with a new set of colourful stacking rings

lines.t: You really love your new stacking rings!
Do you like your new stacking rings?
Which ring is your favourite colour?
You love these rings, don't you!
You haven't put those rings down since we got them!

items.scene: guessing whether a round lump under the blanket is the cat

lines.t: I think that lump under the blanket might be kitty!
Do you think that's the cat under the blanket?
What do you think that round lump is under there?
That's kitty, don't you think?
That lump isn't just a pillow, I think it's kitty!

items.scene: wondering if the mystery parcel is the new ball that was ordered

lines.t: I wonder if that parcel is your new ball!
Do you think that parcel is your new ball?
What do you think is inside that parcel?
It might be your new ball, mightn't it?
We can't be sure until we open it!

src: do you have one for me?

items.scene: asking the toddler to share a cracker at snack time

lines.t: You have an extra cracker for me!
Do you have a cracker to share with me?
Which cracker is for me?
You have one for me, don't you?
You don't have to share if you really want them all!

items.scene: asking if there is a sticker left for the parent too

lines.t: You have a sticker to give me!
Is there a sticker in there for me too?
Which sticker are you going to give me?
There's one for me, right?
Don't use them all up, I want one too!

items.scene: a parent not thinking the toy elephant will fit in the small bag

lines.t: I don't think the big elephant fits in that bag!
Do you think the elephant will fit in the bag?
Why won't the elephant fit in the bag?
The elephant is too big, isn't it?
That elephant won't squeeze into such a small bag!

items.scene: doubting there is room for one more toy in the overfull toy box

lines.t: I don't think one more toy will fit in there!
Do you think there is room for one more?
How will we fit one more toy in the box?
It's pretty full already, isn't it?
I don't think the lid will close if we put more in!

items.scene: being stumped by a toddler's question about why dogs wag their tails

lines.t: That's a really hard question about doggy's tail!
Do you know why doggy wags his tail?
Why do you think dogs wag their tails?
It means he's happy, doesn't it?
I'm not sure of the answer to that one!

items.scene: not knowing where the other sock ended up after the wash

lines.t: The other sock is a complete mystery!
Have you seen the other stripy sock?
Where do you think socks hide after the wash?
It's a mystery, isn't it?
I really don't know where that sock went!

items.scene: picking just one strawberry from the bowl at breakfast

lines.t: I'll just take one little strawberry!
Is it okay if I take one strawberry?
Which strawberry should I take?
Just one, right?
I'm not taking all of them, just one!

items.scene: taking just one piece of the toddler's play-dough

lines.t: I'll just take one tiny bit of the play-dough!
May I have just one little piece of your play-dough?
Which colour play-dough can I have a bit of?
Just a tiny bit, right?
I won't take it all, just one little piece!

items.scene: knowing that grandma always keeps biscuits in the top cupboard

lines.t: Grandma always keeps biscuits in the top cupboard!
Do you know grandma always has biscuits?
Where does grandma keep the biscuits?
Grandma always has biscuits, doesn't she?
Grandma never runs out of biscuits for you!

items.scene: knowing that the cat always sleeps on the sunny window ledge

lines.t: Kitty always sleeps on the sunny window ledge!
Do you know kitty always naps on the ledge?
Where does kitty always go to sleep?
She always naps there, doesn't she?
Kitty never sleeps anywhere else when the sun is out!
